blocking_findings.mechanism: root.resolve is checked before root.lstat/open. O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final root entry; higher ancestors are traversed by absolute lstat/open and are not pinned or rechecked. Swapping one ancestor to a symlink after resolve makes before/open/after all describe another root, yielding foreign allowed-name bytes as read_complete true and custody_race false.
blocking_findings.minimal_remedy: Open root by an O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW dir-fd walk from a trusted stable anchor, recording/checking every ancestor link, or accept a separately trusted pre-opened root fd with bound identity. Do not rely on resolve followed by an absolute open; reject/mark ancestor changes and retain any observations. Extend below-root link/race discipline to the root path itself.
blocking_findings.title: Root canonicality can race before unanchored absolute-path open

blocking_findings.mechanism: JSON/JSONL parse runs outside collection try/finally and catches only ValueError/UnicodeError. A bounded40001-byte depth20000 JSON triggers RecursionError; JSONL with an earlier valid line similarly escapes without returning raw or earlier parsed rows.
blocking_findings.minimal_remedy: Retain parser resource exceptions such as RecursionError as structured parse_errors and return already captured raw/previous row evidence. Keep parsing/serialization resource bounds explicit; do not change global recursion limits or let later parsing discard earlier bytes. Whole-reader outer runtime/serialization safety remains a separate pending gate.
blocking_findings.title: Parser resource error escapes after raw capture and discards result
